Separate exact Bareiss determinants and Faddeev–LeVerrier characteristic-polynomial recurrence confirm the order and rank; all checks passed from actual package code.

value.rationale: The resolved boundary is canonical for the first composite-degree Ceva Fermat multinet, and the complete integral component group is a natural exact invariant for semistable Jacobian degeneration. The nine 11-primary cyclic factors are nonobvious from geometric multiplicities 3 and 4 and are not recoverable from degree statistics or spanning-tree totals. The degree-four case reveals a nontrivial arithmetic obstruction, rather than a chosen arbitrary graph slice.
